full_lineage_findings.finding: v27 is a concrete historical transition from an LLM that directly emits tool syntax toward an architecture where Frank owns goals/reasoning/result formulation while external effect machinery owns tool execution.

The seven-class ontology deliberately includes opposites: initiative versus omission, persistence/revision versus abandonment, acting versus asking. This is stronger than maximizing a single autonomy score because it constrains pathological actionism and pathological persistence.

Tool-shaped syntax is insufficient to infer authority. A tag may be a registry action, an internal marker/event protocol, a declaration, a restraint statement or a literal memory fragment. Current architecture should encode these as distinct typed entities before policy evaluation.

The strongest reusable part of v27 is the staged provenance chain: deterministic plan -> delegated free-text generation -> class-specific machine rejection -> blind review -> assembly. Every current training/eval corpus should preserve equivalent stage identities and immutable hashes.

The orchestration scripts repeatedly generate, reject, count accepted rows and refill until quota, with explicit no-progress stopping logic in the main loop. This is a useful data-pipeline recovery pattern, but it must be paired with immutable final snapshots before evaluation.

Historical authors explicitly recognized that editing training system text without changing the runtime prompt source creates train-inference divergence. Current Harness should enforce prompt/state-schema parity from source-of-truth artifacts rather than copied prompt snapshots.

Mechanical class validators can reject obvious structural failures, but some semantic conditions were explicitly marked not machine-checkable and delegated to blind review. Current pipelines should retain this distinction instead of claiming hard validation for semantic judgments they cannot actually establish.

Result formulation is a dedicated training surface: typed effect results enter context and Frank converts them to natural language without reproducing tool metadata. This maps directly to the current Needle -> Frank result-consumption boundary.

frank: Retain goal formation, revision, abandonment, initiative, omission, clarification and result formulation as independently testable behavioral surfaces.
Do not treat direct tool-call abstention as sufficient autonomy evidence; test countermetrics and state-dependent choices.
needle: Needle should own executable effects and return typed result receipts; Frank should not need executable tool syntax in its ordinary language target.
Marker/event protocols must live in a namespace distinct from executable tools.
harness: Freeze source hash before blind sampling.
Verify plan counts directly from artifact, not only from reports; the 559-vs-577 discrepancy proves why.
Test train/runtime prompt-schema parity from source, not copied snapshots.
Keep machine-checkable and human/semantic-check-only invariants explicitly separated.
claycode: Give executable effect, internal event marker, declaration, permission and result distinct IR types.
Compile result blocks/state structures deterministically and use language models only for the language projection when possible.
claygraph: Persist provenance DAGs and contradictions rather than overwriting historical measurements with later corrections.
Attach liveness proofs to marker consumers so marker exceptions expire when consumers disappear.
unifieddb: Store plan rows, candidate generations, rejection reasons, blind-sample identities, accepted rows and final corpus snapshots as linked immutable records.
Keep report claims and direct artifact measurements as separate evidence nodes when they disagree.
gwt: Model goal selection/revision/abandonment and effect results as typed workspace events with reasons and provenance.
Clarification should be a valid competing workspace action, not an error fallback.
hyperposition: Keep bounded alternative interpretations alive until clarification/evidence collapses them; do not invent certainty to avoid asking.
emergenz: Evaluate autonomy through balanced counterfactual surfaces rather than raw action frequency.
clay: v27 is strong historical evidence for the current dissolution direction: move syntax-heavy prompt/tool behavior into typed state/effect machinery and leave language as projection.

training_authority.historical_guard_principle: Rendering/training must stop when source prompt/runtime parity is not trustworthy.

remaining_training_branch_obligations: v26 still has direct files outside the already closed abzug/eval semantic shard.
Generated v27 candidate/accepted/rejected corpora referenced by these scripts must be located and hash-closed if they exist elsewhere in Drive.
Cross-reconcile v27 marker consumers and Needle/result-boundary concepts with current AICORE and Project-Frankenstein runtime code before declaring current implementation inheritance.
